newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says taken on $897 mln foreign debt in '96.
newsitem.headline: Peru says taken on $897 mln foreign debt in '96.

text.p: Peru's Economy Minister Jorge Camet told Congress late Wednesday the government had contracted $897 million in new foreign debt so far this year.
According to the 1996 budget, the government could take on a further $1.103 billion during the rest of the year, he added.
"We will soon contract the majority of this leftover portion," Camet said.
Part of the $1.103 bilion "leftover," would be accounted for by a new $615 billion loan from Japan that was announced at the end of last month, he added. -- Saul Hudson, Lima newsroom, 511 221-2134
